title: National Commission's Obligation to Function at Specified Locations

content.scenario: The National Commission is required to function at the National Capital Region and perform its functions at other places notified by the Central Government in consultation with the National Commission.
content.outcome: The National Commission functions at the National Capital Region and performs its functions at other specified locations, including regional Benches established by the Central Government.

user_queries: Where is the National Commission required to function?
Can the National Commission function at locations other than the National Capital Region?
What is the process for establishing regional Benches of the National Commission?
